content: Is Saad te Megbevayà ki David
Diyè en si Hadì David med-ubpà te turuǥan din, ne mibeǥayan te Nengazen te kelinew is ginhedian din, he wazè en igkaandam he edsurung.

Ne sevaha he andew, migkeǥiyan ni David is ebpeneuven he si Natan te, “Kayi e en guntaan med-ubpà te utew mekempet he ubpeey he is menge pengawid din, ne ebpuun te kayu he sidru, piru haazà is Kavan te Kebpekid-uyun te Megbevayà ne zutun dà te tulda.”
Midtavak si Natan dutun te hadì te, “Beeli nu is egkesuatan nu te ebaal, su is Nengazen eduma kenikew.”
Piru te haazà he kezukileman mibpekidlalag is Nengazen ki Natan te,
“Genat ka, ne keǥiyi is suluǥuen ku he si David he iyan heini migkaǥi ku: ‘Iyan ke ves ebpehitindeg te valey he ed-ubpaan ku?
Wazè e pa mekeubpà te valey he zutun a ed-ezapa is Megbevayà puun pa te timpu te kebpeǥewasa ku te menge Israilihanen puun te Ehipto taman guntaan. Nekehalinhalin ad is diyà ed-ubpà te tulda.

Hein kedhalinhalin ku he zuma ku is menge etew ku he Israilihanen, wazà ad megkaǥi ziyà te menge pengulu, he midsuǥù ku te ked-elima kandan, te maan is wazè e zan tukuzi te utew mekempet he valey he zutun a ed-ezapa he sidru is menge pengawid din.’
“Keǥiyi nu pa si David he iyan a, is Nengazen he Mekeǥeǥehem, egkaǥi te, ‘Mibantey ke zà dengan te menge kerehidu, piru mibpilì ku sikew he edumala te menge etew ku he Israilihanen.

Midumahan ku sikew minsan hendei ka mebpevayà, ne impezaag ku kenikew is langun he kuntada nu. Guntaan edhimuwen ku sikew he mevantug iring te zuma he menge etew he egkevantug diyan te tivuuk he kelibutan.
Mibeǥayan ku en is menge etew ku he Israilihanen te ubpeey he pirmeninti, para zuen dan en keugelingen he ubpeey he wazè en ebpekesamuk kandan wey ebpekezaagdaag iring duen te nehuna,

puun pa te timpu te kedsevuki ku te menge pengulu te menge etew ku he Israilihanen. Ebeǥayan ku te kelinew is ginhedian nu, ne wazè en kuntada he ebpekeseled dutun. Iyan a, is Nengazen, migkaǥi kenikew he iyan edhadì layun is sevaha te menge kevuwazan nu.
Emun ebpatey kad ne idleveng ka zuma te menge kepuun nu, ibpuli ku kenikew is sevaha te menge anak nu, ne edlig-enan ku is ginhedian din.
Iyan sikandin ebangun te valey para te kebeǥey kedì te zengeg, wey edsigureduwen ku he is menge kevuwazan din ebpekahadì taman te taman.
Egkehimu he iyan a amey zin, ne iyan daan sikandin anak ku. Emun ebpekesalà sikandin, ne ebmensuwen ku sikandin iring te kebmansu te amey te anak din.
Piru kenà egkaawà is kebmahala ku kandin, kenà iring te mid-ulaula ku ki Saul he nepuliyan nu he hadì.
Ebpedayun te wazà pidtemanan is kenikew he ginhedian, ne is menge kevuwazan nu taman te taman is kedhadì dan.’ ”
Midtudtul ni Natan ki David is langun he impezayag te Megbevayà diyà te kandin.
Is menge Pengemuyù ni David

Dutun midseled si Hadì David dutun te Tulda he zutun kes Kavan te Kebpekid-uyun. Ne mibpinuu sikandin diyà te etuvangan te Nengazen ne mibpengemuyù te, “He Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, hentei e ves wey is pemilya ku maan is midtuvazan a kenikew te iring kayi?
Ne guntaan, Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, duen pa penaad nu mehitenged te egkepaabut te pemilya ku. Iyan be heini kes neleyaman en he ebeelan nu te etew?
Hengkey pe be is egkekaǥi ku kenikew, Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ? Su netuenan nu en man ke hentei a is suluǥuen nu.
Tenged te insaad nu wey egkesuatan nu, mibeelan nu heini is dekelà he menge vaal wey mibpetuenan nu heini kediey te suluǥuen nu.
“Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, utew ka iyan gemhanan! Wazà iyan ebpekerepeng kenikew wey wazè en minsan hentei pa he Megbevayà gawas kenikew. Wazè dey nezineg he megbevayà he iring kenikew.

Wey wazè en daan menge etew he iring te keet-etawan nu he menge Israilihanen. Iyan dà heini nasyun kayi te kelibutan he midluwas nu te kegkeuripen wey mehimu he keet-etawan nu. Nehimu ka he ventuǥan tenged te ǥehem nu wey egkein-inuwan he menge vaal nu hein midsegseg nu is menge etew ziyà te menge nasyun wey is menge ed-ezapen dan pinaaǥi te menge keet-etawan nu he midluwas nu puun te Ehipto.
Midhimu nu is menge Israilihanen he keet-etawan nu te wazà pidtemanan, wey iyan ka, Nengazen he Megbevayè dan.

“Ne ǥuntaan, Nengazen he Megbevayà, tumana nu is menge saad nu kedì te suluǥuen nu wey te pemilya ku, para iyan ka mevantug te wazà pidtemanan. Ne egkaǥi is menge etew te, ‘Is Nengazen he Mekeǥeǥehem iyan Megbevayà te Israel!’ Ne is kedhadì te pemilya ku ebpedayun taman te taman.

Nengazen he Mekeǥeǥehem, Megbevayà te Israel, zuen ku kevurut te kebpengemuyù kayi ziyà te kenikew tenged te impahayag nu kedì te suluǥuen nu he layun duen egkehimu he hadì he sevaha te menge kevuwazan ku.
Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ, iyan ka kes tutuu he Megbevayà! Insaad nu heini is menge meupiya kedì te suluǥuen nu, ne utew egkeseriǥi is menge saad nu.

Egkesuatan ku he igkelipey nu is kedtuvazi nu te pemilya ku wey mebpedayun heini minsan keenu ziyà te etuvangan nu, su iyan heini menge saad nu, Nengazen he MEGBEVAYÀ. Ne tenged kayi te kedtuvad nu, egkezeyzey is pemilya ku taman te taman.”
